## Risk mapping

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Read rasters

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(terra)
library(here)


# Load habitat TIFF files
tiff_files <- list.files(here("outputs", "raster", "fish_weighted"),
                         full.names = TRUE)

# Load the first file
tiff_r <- rast(tiff_files[1])
crs(tiff_r)

# Read NetCDF file - noise raster
noise_r <- rast(here("data", "noise_raster", "jomopans_2022", "jomopans_finegrid_nonLinearAbs_2022_date01-2020.nc4"))

# View information
print(noise_r)
names(noise_r)
crs(noise_r)

# Plot first layer
plot(noise_r[[2]])
plot(tiff_r)

# Reproject and align to TIFF
noise_aligned <- project(
  noise_r,
  crs(tiff_r),
  method = "bilinear"
)

# Plot aligned raster
plot(noise_aligned)

```

Reproject and reorient the noise maps.

```{r}

# Copy original raster
noise_fixed <- noise_r

# Swap x and y coordinates by transposing the raster
noise_fixed <- t(noise_fixed)

# Assign correct geographical extent
ext(noise_fixed) <- ext(
  -5.225, 13.225,
  50.8875, 62.1125)

# Set coordinate system
crs(noise_fixed) <- "OGC:CRS84"

# Plot corrected raster
plot(noise_fixed[[2]])

# Flip the corrected noise raster vertically
noise_corrected <- flip(noise_fixed, direction = "vertical")

# Check orientation
plot(
  noise_corrected[[2]],
  col = hcl.colors(100, "YlOrRd"),
  main = "Noise raster - corrected orientation"
)

#Reproject to match TIFF
noise_aligned <- project(
  noise_corrected,
  tiff_r,
  method = "bilinear"
)

plot(
  noise_aligned[[2]],
  col = hcl.colors(100, "YlOrRd")
)
```

Overlay noise and species core area maps.

```{r}

plot(
  tiff_r[[1]],
  main = "Species core areas + Noise overlay"
)

plot(
  noise_aligned[[1]],
  add = TRUE,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "YlOrRd"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  legend = FALSE
)
```

## Risk matrix

- **Species core area:** 1–6, where 6 = spawning area.

- **Noise level:** 1–5, where 5 = critical noise.

![](images/clipboard-966646609.png)

```{r}
# Classify original noise raster
noise_class <- classify(
  noise_aligned[[2]],
  rcl = matrix(c(
    -Inf, 80, 1,
    80, 90, 2,
    90, 100, 3,
    100, 110, 4,
    110, Inf, 5
  ), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  right = FALSE
)

# Five discrete colours
noise_colors <- c(
  "#39E75F",  # 1 - Very low
  "#A3EF49",  # 2 - Acceptable
  "#F5E64B",  # 3 - Concerning
  "#F5A04B",  # 4 - Severe
  "#F24B4B"   # 5 - Critical
)

# Create two panels, with more space for the legend
layout(
  matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1),
  widths = c(3, 2)
)

# Plot noise raster
par(mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

terra::plot(
  noise_class,
  col = noise_colors,
  breaks = seq(0.5, 5.5, by = 1),
  maxcell = ncell(noise_class),
  main = "Noise categories",
  legend = FALSE
)

# Legend panel
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))

plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

graphics::legend(
  x = 0.05,
  y = 0.7,
  legend = c(
    "< 80 dB",
    "80–<90 dB",
    "90–<100 dB",
    "100–<110 dB",
    "≥ 110 dB"
  ),
  fill = noise_colors,
  title = "Noise level (dB)",
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.9,
  xjust = 0,
  yjust = 1
)
# Reset plotting layout
layout(1)
```

Create the risk color matrix and combine the two rasters.

```{r}

library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthhires)
library(sf)

risk_colors <- matrix(c(
  "#3CF24F", "#60EF44", "#86ED41", "#A8F044", "#C7EF4B", "#E8EF4E",
  "#6BF148", "#91EF47", "#B6ED4C", "#D9EF50", "#F3F04E", "#F5D453",
  "#9BED4C", "#C5ED4F", "#DCED50", "#F2E74D", "#F2C454", "#F3A45A",
  "#C9F04C", "#EFF04F", "#F4D951", "#F3BC55", "#F39A55", "#F47B55",
  "#F1EF50", "#F5D552", "#F3B255", "#F58D51", "#F56D51", "#F34E50"
), nrow = 5, byrow = TRUE)

# Species raster
species <- tiff_r[[1]]

# Classify species core areas
species_class <- classify(
  species,
  rcl = matrix(c(
    0, 1, 1,
    1, 2, 2,
    2, 3, 3,
    3, 4, 4,
    4, 5, 5,
    5, 6, 6
  ), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  right = TRUE
)

# Preserve original category 0 and spawning area 6
species_class <- ifel(species == 0, 0, species_class)
species_class <- ifel(species == 6, 6, species_class)

# Check both rasters use the same grid
compareGeom(species_class, noise_class)

plot(
  species_class,
  col = hcl.colors(6, "Viridis"),
  breaks = seq(0.5, 6.5, by = 1),
  main = "Atlantic herring - winter core areas"
)

# Calculate combined risk code
combined_risk <- (noise_class - 1) * 6 + species_class

# Keep only valid classified cells
combined_risk <- ifel(
  species_class == 0,0, combined_risk)

combined_risk <- ifel(
  species_class == 0 |
    (species_class %in% 1:6 & noise_class %in% 1:5),combined_risk,NA)

names(combined_risk) <- "Noise-habitat risk"

# Original risk matrix colours
risk_palette <- as.vector(t(risk_colors))

# Add light grey for species class 0
risk_palette <- c("#D9D9D9",risk_palette)

# Get country boundaries
countries <- ne_countries(scale = 10,returnclass = "sv")

# Reproject countries to match TIFF
countries <- project(countries,crs(tiff_r))

# Crop to your study area, with some surrounding land
map_extent <- extend(ext(tiff_r), 150000)

countries_northsea <- crop(countries,map_extent)

# Plot combined raster
plot(combined_risk,
  col = risk_palette,
  breaks = seq(-0.5, 30.5, by = 1),
  maxcell = ncell(combined_risk),
  legend = FALSE,
  ext = map_extent,
  main = "Atlantic herring - winter noise-habitat risk")

# Add country borders and coastline
plot(countries_northsea,
  add = TRUE,
  col = NA,
  border = "black",
  lwd = 0.8)
```

Add legend to the map

```{r}
# Reset plotting layout
layout(1)

# Colours
risk_palette <- c(
  "#D9D9D9",
  as.vector(t(risk_colors)))

# Map extent
map_extent <- extend(ext(tiff_r), 150000)

# Reserve space for title and legend
par(mar = c(4, 4, 4, 2))

# 1. Plot land
plot(
  countries_northsea,
  col = "#EFEFEF",
  border = NA,
  ext = map_extent,
  main = "",
  axes = TRUE)

# 2. Add combined risk raster
plot(
  combined_risk,
  add = TRUE,
  col = risk_palette,
  breaks = seq(-0.5, 30.5, by = 1),
  maxcell = ncell(combined_risk),
  legend = FALSE
)

# 3. Add country borders
plot(
  countries_northsea,
  add = TRUE,
  col = NA,
  border = "#333333",
  lwd = 0.6
)

# 4. Add title
title(
  main = "",
  cex.main = 1.1,
  line = 2
)

# 5. Get map coordinates
usr <- par("usr")

xrange <- diff(usr[1:2])
yrange <- diff(usr[3:4])

# 6. Position legend INSIDE plotting coordinates
x_left  <- usr[2] - 0.18 * xrange
x_right <- usr[2] - 0.13 * xrange

y_bottom <- usr[3] + 0.25 * yrange
y_top    <- usr[3] + 0.75 * yrange

# 7. Gradient colours
gradient_colors <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#3CF24F",
  "#A8F044",
  "#F1EF50",
  "#F3A45A",
  "#F34E50"
))(100)

# 8. Draw colour bar
y_breaks <- seq(y_bottom, y_top, length.out = 101)

for (i in 1:100) {
  rect(
    x_left,
    y_breaks[i],
    x_right,
    y_breaks[i + 1],
    col = gradient_colors[i],
    border = NA
  )
}

# Colour bar outline
rect(
  x_left, y_bottom,
  x_right, y_top,
  border = "black"
)

# Legend title
text(
  x_left,
  y_top + 0.05 * yrange,
  "Risk level",
  adj = 0,
  font = 2,
  cex = 0.9
)

# Labels
text(
  x_right + 0.02 * xrange,
  y_top,
  "High risk",
  adj = 0,
  cex = 0.8
)

text(
  x_right + 0.02 * xrange,
  y_bottom,
  "Low risk",
  adj = 0,
  cex = 0.8
)

# GREY LEGEND: NO SPECIES CORE AREA
# ---------------------------------

# Position grey box below the colour bar
grey_bottom <- y_bottom - 0.12 * yrange
grey_top    <- y_bottom - 0.08 * yrange

# Draw grey box
rect(
  xleft = x_left,
  ybottom = grey_bottom,
  xright = x_right,
  ytop = grey_top,
  col = "#D9D9D9",
  border = "black"
)

# Add label
text(
  x = x_right + 0.02 * xrange,
  y = (grey_bottom + grey_top) / 2,
  labels = "Not identified\nas a species\ncore area",
  adj = c(0, 0.5),
  cex = 0.65,
  xpd = NA)
```
